entries.description: The viewer owns a Form & Decorate Tech, so they have added the second Form & Decorate space; they have not yet added the second Glaze & Load space. Placement options, quotes and the Commission / Guild / Magistrate option lists are for this exact state.
entries.name: 3P · Round 2 · Work Phase · your turn (before action)

entries.description: The viewer's Shifu was placed at the Commission Market, which opened its Select 3: a private look at the top 3 Main Orders (v1.6.2 L80, L226). own.pendingLook holds the 3 Orders; other players only see counts.pendingLook (kind + count). The viewer now reserves 1 or 2, in any mix of those 3 and the display (SELECT_CHOOSE); a face-up position stays empty until the turn ends, and the looked cards not reserved are discarded face down to the Main Order discard (owner ruling R25). No resource is gained.

steered.why: Shifu to the Commission Market: the placement opens the private Select 3.

entries.description: Kiln Die and Base Heat after the revealed Contributions are known (Test Pieces, before the Fire card, or Jun, before Quality). A loaded ceramic carries Kiln Master's +1 or −1 marker, chosen face up when it was loaded (L647, R22), and the marker adds to its Actual Heat; there is no Heat-marker step since revision 4. The firing stage shows the marker on its ceramic and no heat preview (D3/D4).
entries.name: 3P · Firing · Kiln Master's marker before the Fire card or Quality

entries.description: Quality has been assigned. The viewer chooses after-Quality abilities in their own order (Ge Crackle, Protective Saggars, Second Firing), rechecked after each use. heatLadder.chips carries each ceramic's Actual Heat, Heat Difference and Quality.
entries.name: 3P · Firing · after-Quality window (step 5)

steered.why: Seat p1 takes GE (and the leftmost face-up Main Order) so the fixture shows its ability.

entries.description: In a 2-player game the Shared Kiln has 4 active spaces (High 2, Middle 1, Low 1); covered spaces are active:false in boardView.kilnSpaces. The Magistrate's Hall has capacity 1 (kilnLayout.centralCapacities).
entries.name: 2P · Work Phase · 2-1-1 Shared Kiln and 1-space Magistrate's Hall

entries.description: Only held Orders can be completed. The Order Phase is one First-Player-order pass of free-action turns after the firing, the first chance to deliver this round's ceramics; held Orders can also be completed as free actions before or after a worker action (change 36). completableOrders gives one entry per completable held Order (its first match); orderMatchOptions lists every distinct ceramic group with the Crackle declarations that would be recorded; crackleDeclarationChecks run the validator's matcher (orderSelectionCheck) for each Decoration a Crackle ceramic could declare, so a declaration picker never re-implements Order rules. Each delivered Crackle ceramic scores 1 VP with the Order (L484; orderMatchOptions[].triggers.crackleVp, CompletedOrderRecord.crackleVp).
entries.name: 3P · Order Phase · completable held Orders with Crackle wildcard

steered.why: Seat p1 takes GE (and the leftmost face-up Main Order) so the fixture shows its ability.

entries.description: Cleanup step 2 (Rounds 1–4 only): the viewer holds more than the limit (4, or 5 with Colour Samples) and must discard exactly the excess. The prompt is parallel; other players' hands stay hidden (only counts).
entries.name: 3P · Cleanup · trim Orders to the hand limit

entries.description: FinalResult with each player's breakdown: orders, kilnAbilities, recognitionOverflow, imperialAudience, exhibition (quality VP + Shape/Glaze diversity bonuses), connoisseur, coins, total (Advanced Techs score no VP, v1.6.2 change 27); standings with tie-break values (Recognition, printed Crowns, Masterpieces) and resolvedBy.
entries.name: 3P · Final results

entries.description: Contributions are chosen secretly and simultaneously. phase.submittedPlayerIds shows who has submitted, never what; the viewer's own choice is not yet sealed. contributionOptions lists 1 option per Contribution card the viewer holds: Tend / Bank / Stoke, and Fuel Ledger Bank / Fuel Ledger Stoke when Fuel Ledger is owned (v1.6.2 change 26), with Wood cost (paid on reveal) and affordability.
entries.name: 3P · Firing · step 1 · secret Contributions

entries.description: The viewer's Shifu inspected the top Techs of one discipline: only they see them (guildInspectionOptions). They take up to 2 Techs from different disciplines, inspected or face-up, each at its printed cost (v1.6.2 L237), then choose the bottom order of the rest (GUILD_FINISH).

entries.description: The viewer holds a Finished Flawed ceramic and it is their Order Phase turn, a free-action window (rev. 5 L170): they may sell it for 2 Coins as a free action, its Vessel card back to the supply (sellFlawedOptions), complete Orders, or end the turn. The turn opens for a Flawed ceramic even with nothing to complete (R28). The firing-step salvage of revision 3 is gone.

notes: The gallery opens it with this choice made (draftCommand): the sale of the first sellable Flawed ceramic is chosen (its Sell button pressed).

entries.description: Setup step 9 (L130, R23): in reverse turn order each player, in one turn, takes one of the five Kiln Player Boards and 1 face-up Main Order from the display, which is refilled to 6 before the next player (setupChoiceOptions, kilnSelectionOptions). The take is public. The viewer chooses first.
entries.name: 4P · Setup · Kiln and Main Order choice (reverse turn order)
notes: The gallery opens it with this choice made (draftCommand): the Ge Kiln and the third face-up Main Order are chosen (the display's Choose toggle pressed).

No resource is gained.
entries.name: 3P · Work Phase · Commission Market: Apprentice Selects 2 (private look)

entries.description: Before their worker action the viewer used the Colour Samples swap (T10, once per round): they discarded 1 held Order (a Main Order face down to the discard, a Starting Order to the box) and their Select 3 is open: a private look at the top 3 Main Orders. They reserve 1 of those 3 or 1 face-up Main Order (SELECT_CHOOSE; a face-up position stays empty until their turn ends); the looked cards not reserved are discarded face down (v1.6.2 L632, change 25, owner ruling R25). Then they place a worker as usual.

steered.why: An Apprentice buys Colour Samples (T10) at the Guild Hall so the fixture can show it.

entries.description: The viewer's Shifu inspected a Tech deck and has taken 1 Tech at its printed cost. Its position on the display stays empty until the turn ends (v1.6.2 L239). They may take a second Tech of another discipline, inspected or face up, at its printed cost (GUILD_TAKE), or stop and put the untaken inspected Techs on the bottom in an order they choose (GUILD_FINISH; guildInspectionOptions).

The viewer owns Kiln Master (T24): once per round, as a ceramic is loaded, its +1 or −1 marker may go on it, face up and public (L647, R22; kilnMasterOption, LoadSpec.kilnMaster). entries.description: Before their worker action the viewer can complete a held Order with their Finished ceramics: completing held Orders is a free action, on their own turn before or after the worker action and in their Order Phase turn (owner revision 5, change 36, rev. 5 L168–176; freeActionOptions.completableOrderIds). Its Coins and Crowns count for the placement that follows. Ceramics fired this round are first available after the firing.

notes: The gallery opens it with this choice made (draftCommand): the completion of the first held Order the viewer can complete is chosen.

entries.description: After their worker action the viewer holds a Finished Flawed ceramic: the after-action step opens on public facts (owner ruling R27), and they may sell it for 2 Coins as a free action (its Vessel card back to the supply), take another free action, or end the turn (sellFlawedOptions; rev. 5 L172, L302). Nothing is sold during the firing or at Cleanup (R26).

entries.description: In their Order Phase turn, the post-firing free-action window (owner ruling R28), the viewer may spend Imperial Priority: a Shaped vessel is glazed and loaded into their empty Imperial Kiln, free, with a public Imperial modifier (rev. 5 L174, L314). This round's firing is over, so the ceramic waits in the Imperial Kiln and is fired in the next round's firing; in Round 5 it is never fired, which the form says plainly. Kiln Master's one marker would wait with it (R32).
entries.name: Order Phase · Imperial Priority after the firing (a free action)
notes: The gallery opens it with this choice made (draftCommand): Imperial Priority on the first Shaped vessel is chosen (its pending chip shows in the Imperial Kiln).

entries.description: The viewer owns the Ge Kiln: once per round, after Quality, 1 of their ceramics from this firing, of any Quality, gains a Crackle marker; only a Standard one becomes Fine (change 39, rev. 5 L482, owner ruling R30). Here a Masterpiece: it stays a Masterpiece with a Crackle marker (CRACKLE_APPLIED, no QUALITY_IMPROVED); as a Crackle ceramic it may count as any one Decoration and scores 1 VP when delivered.
entries.name: 3P · Firing step 5 · Ge's Crackle on a Masterpiece
notes: The gallery opens it with this choice made (draftCommand): Ge on the viewer's Masterpiece is chosen; it keeps its Quality.

steered.why: Seat p1 takes GE (and the leftmost face-up Main Order) so the fixture shows its ability.

entries.description: Ge may crackle a Flawed ceramic of the firing too (change 39, owner ruling R30): it gains a Crackle marker and stays Flawed (a Flawed ceramic never completes an Order and is never exhibited, so the marker brings nothing unless a Second Firing improves it; the marker survives that recalculation). Never assume Crackle means Fine.
entries.name: 3P · Firing step 5 · Ge's Crackle on a Flawed ceramic
notes: The gallery opens it with this choice made (draftCommand): Ge on the viewer's Flawed ceramic is chosen; it keeps its Quality.

steered.why: Seat p1 takes GE (and the leftmost face-up Main Order) so the fixture shows its ability.

It does not count against the action's vessel limit, and not toward the Shifu's "if you form 2" discount (owner ruling R29); the quote shows it as one row.
entries.name: 3P · Work Phase · Form & Decorate with Ding's extra vessel: 1 Clay + 2 Coins
notes: The gallery opens it with this choice made (draftCommand): a Form & Decorate placement with Ding's extra vessel is chosen (its 1 Clay + 2 Coins in the quote).
